instruction.text: Ergänze im Dialog die passenden Fragewörter.

atoms.a: Hallo Defne. Mir geht es gut. Wie geht es dir?
atoms.b: Hello Defne. I'm fine. ((++How Where)) are you?
atoms.sound: Hello Defne. I'm fine. How are you?

atoms.a: Mir geht es auch gut. Willst du mit mir und meinen Freunden ins Kino gehen?
atoms.b: I'm fine too. Do you want to go to the cinema with me and my friends?
atoms.sound: I'm fine too. Do you want to go to the cinema with me and my friends?

atoms.b: Yes. ((++When What)) do you go to the cinema?
atoms.sound: Yes. When do you go to the cinema?

atoms.a: Morgen nach der Schule um 3 Uhr.
atoms.sound: Tomorrow after school at three o'clock.

atoms.a: Warum gehen wir nicht heute ins Kino?
atoms.b: ((++Why Who)) don't we go to the cinema today?
atoms.sound: Why don't we go to the cinema today?

atoms.a: Meine Freunde und ich haben heute ein Basketball Spiel.
atoms.b: My friends and I have a basketball game today.
atoms.sound: My friends and I have a basketball game today.

atoms.b: Okay. ((++Where What)) do we meet tomorrow?
atoms.sound: Okay. Where do we meet tomorrow?

atoms.a: Wir treffen uns vor der Schule.
atoms.b: We meet in front of school.
atoms.sound: We meet in front of school.

atoms.b: Of course, he can come too.
atoms.sound: Of course, he can come too.

atoms.a: Du musst nichts mitbringen. Wir kaufen im Kino etwas zu essen und zu trinken.
atoms.b: You don't have to bring anything. We'll buy something to eat and drink at the cinema.
atoms.sound: You don't have to bring anything. We'll buy something to eat and drink at the cinema.
